title: Approval of Lease No. 1309 with Big Pine Community Service District. The
text:
[N. Items for Approval]
Recommended by Water System
  Approval of Lease No. 1309 with Big Pine Community Service District. The
  Lease will generate an estimated rental revenue of $4,025 over the first five
  years, and rent is subject to renegotiation each five-year period thereafter.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).
